description: This file declares the TransportSecurityPersister class responsible for managing on-disk storage and serialization of transport security state information within the Chromium project. It includes methods for serializing/deserializing state, handling file IO, and integrating with TransportSecurityState.

classes.name: TransportSecurityPersister
classes.description: A class that serializes, deserializes, and manages persistent storage of transport security state data, ensuring thread-safe file IO and state updates.

methods.name: TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persister with state, background task runner, and data file path.

methods.name: StateIsDirty
methods.description: Callback invoked when the security state changes, marking the data as needing to be persisted.

methods.name: WriteNow
methods.description: Immediately serializes and writes the current security state to disk, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current security state into a JSON string, returning an optional string.

methods.name: LoadEntries
methods.description: Loads and applies serialized security state data into the in-memory state.
